concept.title: Dunhald: The Signal Tower
concept.logline: On fog-bound, tense Dunhald, you race to recover the ember stones and restore the Signal Tower.
concept.source_prompt: Glacier Steps. glacier ice icy frozen mission Timed rush
concept.player_fantasy: You are a wanderer who arrives at Hearth Lodge and becomes the one who brings the Signal Tower back to life.

key_locations.name: Hearth Lodge
key_locations.description: The start: a timber lodge dug into the drifts.

key_locations.name: Pine Hollow
key_locations.description: Pine Hollow: a grove of Dunhald, reached by the trail from Hearth Lodge.

key_locations.name: Ice Cavern
key_locations.description: Ice Cavern: a cave on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

key_locations.name: Signal Tower
key_locations.description: Signal Tower: the far end of the compact trail, where the story ends.

characters.name: Warden Isla
characters.description: Waits in Hearth Lodge and knows why the Signal Tower fell silent.

characters.name: Odo the Tracker
characters.description: Follows you from Hearth Lodge and points out anything glinting nearby.

characters.name: Frost Stalker
characters.description: A frost stalker that prowls near its lair and runs down whatever it spots.

characters.name: Frost Wisp
characters.description: A frost wisp that walks the same beat over and over. Learn the loop and slip past.

characters.name: Piet the Trader
characters.description: Trades gossip about Dunhald for anything shiny.

characters.name: Snow Hare
characters.description: A harmless snow hare that bolts if you come too close.

objectives_outline: Light the finale before the clock runs out
hazards: Sheer drops off the trail edges
Frost Stalker hunting near its lair
Frost Wisp patrolling a fixed loop

actions.value: On fog-bound, tense Dunhald, you race to recover the ember stones and restore the Signal Tower.
The clock is already running. Hit every site, then light the finale.
Split: the Ice Cavern. Keep going!
Split: the Pine Hollow. Keep going!
Made it, with time to spare!
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Warden Isla
nodes.text: So you've come to Hearth Lodge at last. I am Warden Isla. On fog-bound, tense Dunhald, you race to recover the ember stones and restore the Signal Tower.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Warden Isla
nodes.text: Back again. Hearth Lodge is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Warden Isla
nodes.text: Go to Pine Hollow, then Ice Cavern. Whatever still remembers Dunhald: The Signal Tower is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Warden Isla
nodes.text: Before anyone lived in Hearth Lodge, Dunhald: The Signal Tower was kept by people who wrote nothing down. Awed, even then.

nodes.speaker: Warden Isla
nodes.text: Pine Hollow: Pine Hollow: a grove of Dunhald, reached by the trail from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Warden Isla
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Dunhald: The Signal Tower back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Warden Isla
nodes.text: Ice Cavern: Ice Cavern: a cave on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Tracker
nodes.text: Odo the Tracker circles your feet, then looks toward Ice Cavern as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Tracker
nodes.text: Odo the Tracker sniffs the air. Something about Ice Cavern has it restless.

nodes.speaker: Odo the Tracker
nodes.text: It turns toward Ice Cavern. Ice Cavern: a cave on the way out from Hearth Lodge.

nodes.speaker: Frost Stalker
nodes.text: The frost stalker watches you, low and still. It is not going to talk.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Hearth Lodge. Piet the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Dunhald: The Signal Tower that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Piet the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Pine Hollow after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Snow Hare
nodes.text: The snow hare freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
